1.title: The Silent Patient
1.author: Alex Michaelides
1.description: Alicia Berenson’s life is seemingly perfect. One evening, she shoots her husband five times in the face, and then never speaks another word.

2.title: Project Hail Mary
2.author: Andy Weir
2.description: Ryland Grace is the sole survivor on a desperate, last-chance mission—and if he fails, humanity and the earth itself will perish.

3.title: Atomic Habits
3.author: James Clear
3.description: An easy & proven way to build good habits & break bad ones. Learn how tiny changes lead to remarkable results.

4.title: To Kill a Mockingbird
4.author: Harper Lee
4.description: The unforgettable novel of a childhood in a sleepy Southern town and the crisis of conscience that rocked it.

5.title: The Design of Everyday Things
5.author: Don Norman
5.description: Even the smartest among us can feel inept as we try to figure out which light switch or oven burner to turn on.

6.title: The Book of Art
6.author: E. H. Gombrich
6.description: A classic introduction to art history, bringing the world of fine art and architecture to life.
